summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off their 2026/27 campaign with an exciting new-look squad featuring some fantastic additions and returnees. The Ramblers have been preparing well in pre-season, with a competitive friendly against St Helens showing the team is match-ready, and they're also sporting three brand new kits this season. With promotion in their sights, the club is looking for sponsorship partners to support their quest for the upcoming campaign.
